When an unauthorized letter is sent to Moscow alleging the U.S. government's willingness to help Russia attack China, former naval officer Charles Rone and his team are sent to retrieve it. They go undercover, successfully reaching out to Erika Kosnov, the wife of a former agent, now married to the head of Russia's secret police. Their plans are interrupted, however, when their Moscow hideout is raided by a cunning politician.

Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one.

After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group.

The night before his deployment in World War II, wealthy heir Andy Mason (James Ellison) falls in love with Eadie (Alice Faye), a beautiful cabaret singer. The two hit it off, but Mason fails to reveal the fact that he has already promised to marry Vivian (Sheila Ryan), a family friend. When he returns from the war a hero, his father throws a huge party for him, hiring Eadie and her company to perform. Mason hopes to find an out with Vivian in order to marry his true love.

Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.

Un programa que permite seguir emocionantes historias humanas de esfuerzo y coraje, con humor y simpatía, que se suman a la opción inequívoca de permanecer en el terreno como un medio para desarrollar su trabajo.
Un programa sobre meteorología que aborda la actualidad sobre el clima, el medio ambiente y las consecuencias del cambio climático.
Información meteorológica y pronóstico del tiempo, siempre con el apoyo de Meteogalicia.
Un programa para disfrutar de modernas creaciones gastronómicas, en cada episodio una deliciosa receta es realizada mostrándose cómo armonizar los alimentos con el vino.
El resumen deportivo más completo de la jornada, con la información más fresca y dinámica de las disciplinas más relevantes a nivel mundial.
Un programa con los sucesos policiales en el ámbito local y nacional, promoviendo la denuncia del delito y una tribuna para la ciudadanía.
Informativo con los sucesos más trascendentes ocurridos en el ámbito nacional e internacional.
Revista noticiosa de investigación que llega a la teleaudiencia semanalmente.
Un programa con consejos de belleza, moda, estilo de vida, familia y cultura. Un equipo de especialistas orientan al televidente en lo que respecta a la integridad humana.

Un programa cuyo objetivo es lograr el equilibrio entre la mente, el cuerpo y el espíritu. Especialistas comparten conocimientos sobre medicina integral y alternativa y consejos para organizar y armonizar la buena energía en el hogar.
Un programa dedicado al séptimo arte con estrenos en la cartelera, festivales de cine, cortometrajes, biografías de los actores y directores, premiaciones y mucho más.
Información actualizada de la jornada con notas locales, nacionales e internacionales.
Programa deportivo que analiza los distintos procesos y logros deportivos mediante la crónica y la entrevista.
Un programa ameno con información detallada de lo que ocurre en el mundo de la farándula nacional e internacional, con los últimos chismes de los famosos.

Después de que su mejor amiga la contrata para poner a prueba la fidelidad de su pareja, una joven encuentra una nueva carrera lucrativa. Pero los problemas se presentan cuando ella se enamora de la persona que vigila.
Una madre viuda se muda con su hija y descubre que la vida siempre ofrece otra oportunidad para reinventarse y sanar.
Dos mujeres, Alexa y Regina, descubren que fueron estafadas por el mismo hombre, quien además las embarazó. Forzadas a formar una alianza, deciden tomar venganza.
Dos porristas universitarias forman su propio equipo y se preparan para competir contra el equipo de la universidad.

Un perro fiel llamado Hachiko acompaña cada mañana a su amo a la estación de tren y regresa cada tarde para darle la bienvenida después del trabajo. Sin embargo, esta rutina se ve rota por una desgracia.
Jóvenes traviesos manejan una organización en contra de las chicas.

Una estrella del pop descubre que su prometido la engaña momentos antes de su gran boda, así que decide casarse con un completo desconocido del público, sin darse cuenta de que sus vidas, quizá, van a quedar unidas para siempre.
Gracie Hart, agente del FBI, se enfrenta a sus superiores para salvar a dos amigas que fueron secuestradas en Las Vegas.

Un empleado de oficina insomne, harto de su vida, se cruza con un vendedor peculiar. Ambos crean un club de lucha clandestino como forma de terapia y, poco a poco, la organización crece y sus objetivos toman otro rumbo.
Un joven ingeniero chino descubre una conspiración en África cuyo objetivo es obtener un suculento contrato ligado al negocio de la alta tecnología.
Fong es un ladrón que siempre pierde todo lo ganado en las apuestas. Su gran oportunidad llegará de la mano de un mafioso que le pide que secuestre al bebé.
Un asesino a sueldo es transportado a la época medieval y se encuentra con un feroz ejército y un dragón que escupe fuego.
Un soldado de las fuerzas especiales se ve atrapado en un vórtice temporal apareciendo en tiempos medievales. Ahí descubrirá que está destinado a cumplir una profecía y redimir a todo un pueblo.

Mientras se desarrolla una guerra en un reino idílico, un hombre llamado Farmer inicia la heroica búsqueda para encontrar a su esposa secuestrada y vengar a su hijo, quien fue asesinado por unos terribles guerreros llamados Krugs. Mientras tanto, el villano Gallian envía a su ejército de criminales a enfrentar al rey y robar su trono.
Dos albañiles y un estudiante de sismología luchan contra enormes gusanos carnívoros que amenazan a un pueblo de Nevada.

Daniel LaRusso llega a Los Ángeles dispuesto a hacer amigos, pero rápidamente se convierte en el blanco de los ataques de un grupo de estudiantes de karate. Por eso, le pide ayuda a Miyagi, un maestro de artes marciales que cambiará su vida.
Un chico de 13 años que está en un campamento ayuda al presidente de los Estados Unidos cuando su avión cae derribado en Finlandia como consecuencia de un complot terrorista que busca su muerte.

Dane Jensen recibe la oportunidad de ponerse a cargo de la firma Blackridge, aunque eso suponga pasar menos tiempo con su familia. Sin embargo, cuando su hijo es diagnosticado con leucemia, Dane debe reevaluar su vida y sus prioridades.
Con la ayuda de su nuevo compañero, un policía conflictivo recibe la oportunidad de detener a una pandilla de adversarios de su pasado.
Movie, Crime drama, Action, Thriller, Dark comedy
Un hombre se despierta en un parque de Vietnam sin saber quién es. Intenta descubrir su verdadera identidad y comprender su pasado, pero unos seres misteriosos comienzan a perseguirlo.
Chris Wilton, un joven profesor de tenis, se obsesiona con Nola Rice, la seductora prometida de su cuñado.

Sandy, de 40 años, descubre que su marido la engaña y se va a Nueva York. Allí conoce a Aram, de 25 años y a quien ha contratado como niñero. De esta forma, Sandy se da cuenta de que el amor llega, muchas veces, de la manera más insospechada.
Tres viejos amigos viajan a Las Vegas para celebrar el final de la soltería de uno de ellos y revivir sus días de gloria.

Después de salir de la prisión, el ladrón de bancos Zequi se dispone a recuperar el dinero robado que fue enterrado por su cómplice, pero se horroriza al saber que un gimnasio de secundaria está ahora sobre el sitio donde el botín está escondido. Para infiltrarse en el edificio, Zequi consigue un trabajo como maestro sustituto para un grupo de estudiantes indisciplinados y, mientras intenta establecer el orden, se da cuenta de que la vida en la cárcel era más fácil que lidiar con estos jóvenes.
Antes de convertirse en un mimo famoso, el judío Marcel Mangel salvó a miles de niños huérfanos de los nazis mientras estuvo enrolado en la Resistencia francesa.

El novio de Moni, Xavi, muere en un accidente, y ella decide hacer lo que ama: chocolate. Es entonces cuando conoce a Alex, su instructor. El único problema es que ella todavía ve a Xavi en todos lados.

Un disfuncional y divertido grupo de adictos en rehabilitación busca cumplir el sueño de una niña indígena con cáncer terminal. Mientras intentan llevarla de regreso a su hogar, se atreven a enfrentar los errores de sus propios pasados.

Grace es una madre soltera que está muy ocupada con su trabajo, los recibos y dos pretendientes como para ponerle atención a su hija Ansiedad. Inspirada por las historias de su maestra de inglés, Ansiedad decide saltarse la adolescencia y experimentar directamente a una vida sin su madre. Pero, cuando sus planes equivocados se revelan, Ansiedad y Grace deben aprender que el crecer significa actuar de acuerdo a tu edad.
Dos jóvenes amantes tienen sentimientos románticos por el otro, en una sociedad en que los humanos no tienen emociones.
Mientras investiga sobre la muerte de su compañero, un detective descubre la corrupción policíaca y un peligroso secreto acerca de una joven.
Un hospital está listo para ser demolido, pero nadie sabe que una banda criminal oculta millones allí. Ahora, con tan solo 90 minutos, se inicia una desesperada búsqueda del dinero.

En marzo de 1942, se termina de construir el campo de exterminio secreto de Sobibor, en el este de Polonia. Durante los 18 meses siguientes, 250 000 personas son asesinadas allí, en su mayoría judíos. Solo 600 personas son salvadas, por el momento, para trabajar como esclavos. A pesar de la constante amenaza de muerte, un grupo de prisioneros planea lo que será la mayor fuga de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

From El Cardonal at Diamante in Los Cabos, Baja California Sur, Mexico.

🏌️ [Golf] Golf Channel's flagship news program, the nightly "Golf Central" presents highlights from the major golf tours and world events, plus reports and features from tournament sites.
Familias guatemaltecas comparten sus historias e inspiraciones mientras compiten para ganar premios en efectivo y cumplir sus sueños.
Espacio con el objetivo de informarte sobre los mejores eventos, música y todo lo relacionado con la escena musical en Xela y Guatemala.

Aventuras que capturan la imaginación de niños alrededor del mundo con Anita, Luis y su simpático robot, Tuercas. Junto con ellos, niños de todas las edades aprenden sobre las asombrosas historias de la Biblia.
El grupo evangélico Eben Ezer comparte un mensaje de salvación.
Espacio de interés general para la población de Guatemala, enfocado en la realidad nacional.
Un noticiero ágil, dinámico y responsable que ayuda a despertar la conciencia nacional con toda la información de lo acontecido en Guatemala.
Experiencias y testimonios de diversas personalidades a través de conversaciones profundas y honestas.
Cobertura de los eventos relacionados con la Cuaresma y la Semana Santa 2024.
Todo lo relacionado con el séptimo arte. Lo mejor del cine y la televisión, además de coberturas internacionales y entrevistas exclusivas.
Teco, Ron y Rul, son los 3 huitecos que después de más de 5 años en escena llegan a la pantalla chica presentando sus personajes y el humor zacapaneco que los ha caracterizado en sus obras.
Un programa que destaca los secretos mejor guardados de los lugares paradisíacos, de sitios arqueológicos, mostrando el folclore, proyectos eco turísticos y el medio ambiente.
Todas las maravillas del mundo sobre ruedas, desde eventos de velocidad hasta el cuidado de motores.

Un grupo de amigos acude a un circuito de carreras. Durante la competencia, Nick tiene una premonición sobre un accidente y saca a sus amigos del recinto para escapar de la tragedia. El accidente acaba ocurriendo y todos celebran el hecho de estar vivos. Sin embargo, el grupo no ha vencido del todo a la muerte, que volverá para llevarse a los supervivientes de la manera más brutal posible.
Richard Williams, siguiendo un plan determinado y arriesgado, inspira a sus dos hijas, Venus y Serena, a buscar el éxito en el mundo del tenis.

Han pasado 25 años desde que el público recorrió por primera vez los pasillos de Hogwarts. Ahora, se ofrece una mirada al interior de la magnificencia y el meticuloso trabajo que hay detrás de la nueva serie de Harry Potter, contada a través de la perspectiva de los artistas, artesanos y técnicos.

Cal Weaver está viviendo el sueño americano. Él tiene un buen trabajo, una casa preciosa, niños excelentes y una esposa hermosa, llamada Emily. Sin embargo, la aparente vida perfecta de Cal se derrumba cuando descubre que Emily le ha sido infiel y quiere divorciarse. Ahora, con más de 40 años, e inesperadamente soltero, Cal ingresa al vicioso mundo de las citas románticas. Jacob Palmer decide ayudar a Cal y le enseña a tener éxito con las damas.

El multimillonario tecnológico Lex Luthor aprovecha la oportunidad para quitarse de en medio definitivamente al Hombre de Acero. ¿Podrán la reportera Lois Lane y el compañero de cuatro patas de Superman, Krypto, ayudarle antes de que sea tarde?
Movie, Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Fantasy
Después de ser expulsada de Barbieland por no ser una muñeca de aspecto perfecto, Barbie parte hacia el mundo humano para encontrar la verdadera felicidad.

Después de que un virus transforma a la mayoría de las personas en zombis, los humanos sobrevivientes deben luchar contra los muertos vivientes hambrientos. Cuatro sobrevivientes, Tallahassee y sus amigos, Columbus, Wichita y Little Rock, respetan una serie de reglas de supervivencia y estrategias para matar zombis mientras se dirigen a un refugio seguro en Los Ángeles.
Movie, Horror, Comedy, Drama, Action, Adventure
Tres jóvenes se adentran en el Bosque del Oeste, donde se encuentran con un espíritu ancestral.
Billy Batson y sus hermanos adoptivos Freddy, Mary, Pedro, Eugene y Darla, también dotados de superpoderes, tienen que enfrentarse a las tres hijas de Atlas: Hespera, Calipso y Anthea.
Dos hermanos descubren un terrorífico secreto en la apartada casa de su nueva madre adoptiva.
Poco después de que una cita a ciegas acaba con resultados desastrosos, dos padres solteros y sus niños terminan atrapados juntos en un centro turístico africano.
Diana Prince, conocida como Mujer Maravilla, se enfrenta a una villana que posee fuerza y agilidad sobrehumanas.
Todos los niños de la clase, excepto uno, desaparecen misteriosamente en la misma noche y exactamente a la misma hora. La comunidad se pregunta quién o qué está detrás de la desaparición.

A solo dos días del inicio del juicio, Molly se preocupa cada vez más por una lista de activos inexacta, pero Johnny intenta restar importancia a la situación. Tras recibir información inquietante, Serena y Nick se reúnen con sus abogados para hablar del caso. Más tarde, St. John niega tener conocimiento alguno del acuerdo de David.
En el misterioso pueblo de Derry, un payaso llamado Pennywise vuelve 27 años después para atormentar a los ahora adultos miembros del Club de los Perdedores, que se encuentran alejados unos de otros.
Movie, Horror, Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Fantasy

Una nueva especie de dinosaurio, creada por los científicos de forma artificial, más inteligente y peligrosa que las especies conocidas, ataca a los turistas que visitan el parque temático Jurassic World, situado en una isla frente a Costa Rica.
Movie, Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller

Con el malvado mago Gargamel pisándole los talones, Pitufina, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Tontín y Pitufo Fortachón se embarcan en un viaje a través del Bosque Prohibido para encontrar un misterioso pueblo.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy

Tres adolescentes se embarcan en una aventura para reunir a un joven yeti con su familia en el Himalaya, y evitar que esta mítica criatura caiga en manos de un millonario inescrupuloso y un zoólogo que quieren capturarlo para apropiarse de sus poderes mágicos.

Los padres de la princesa y reyes de Muy, Muy Lejano invitan a cenar Shrek y Fiona, pero el rey Harold descubre que su yerno es un ogro y acude al Hada Madrina para alejar a Shrek de Fiona y lograr que se case con el guapo Príncipe Encantador.

Una pequeña cabra llamada Will tiene la oportunidad única de unirse a los profesionales y jugar al roarball, un deporte de alta intensidad y contacto físico total en el que destacan los animales más rápidos y feroces del mundo.
Una familia cavernícola busca un nuevo hogar después de que el suyo sea destruido. Mientras avanzan por un mundo desconocido, se encuentran con un nómada que deja a todos fascinados.

Flint Lockwood descubre que su máquina más famosa ahora está creando híbridos entre alimentos y animales y, junto con sus amigos, se lanzan a la aventura de salvar al mundo de estas extrañas criaturas.

Un ogro llamado Shrek vive en su pantano, pero su preciada soledad se ve súbitamente interrumpida por la invasión de los ruidosos personajes de los cuentos de hadas. Todos fueron expulsados de sus reinos por el malvado Lord Farquaad. Decidido a salvar su hogar, Shrek hace un trato con Farquaad y se prepara para rescatar a la princesa Fiona, quien será la esposa de Farquaad.
Shrek y sus amigos van en busca del verdadero heredero de la Tierra Muy Muy Lejana, mientras la Princesa Fiona intenta evitar que el Príncipe Encantador ocupe el trono.

After many years of marriage, Pete (Paul Rudd) is the sole male in a household that includes his wife, Debbie (Leslie Mann), and two young daughters (Iris Apatow, Maude Apatow). As Pete struggles to keep his record label afloat, he and Debbie navigate a three-week course of sex and romance, career victories and financial hardships, aging parents and maturing children. They'll have to learn to forgive, forget and enjoy the rest of their lives -- before they kill each other.
Comedian John Oliver hosts an in-depth, satirical look at developments from the past seven days in news, politics and current events.

Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.
Two men who lost their respective twin brothers develop a growing friendship after meeting in a support group. However, both harbor long-hidden secrets that threaten to tear them apart.

When Annie (Cameron Diaz) and Jay (Jason Segel) first meet, they have an instant and intense romantic connection. However, 10 years and two children later, the flames of passion have dimmed to dull embers. To bring back the spark, the couple decide to record themselves trying out every position in "The Joy of Sex," which seems like a great idea at the time -- until they discover that their private recording has gone public via the Internet.

When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other.

The death of their childhood basketball coach leads to a reunion for some old friends (Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock), who gather at the site of a championship celebration years earlier. Picking up where they left off, the buddies -- with wives and children in tow -- discover why age does not, necessarily, equal maturity.

Una mirada profunda a las vidas de unos estudiantes de secundaria en tres comunidades radicalmente dispares, mientras se enfrentan a las presiones de ir a la universidad y preparan un musical, pero unos eventos chocantes lo cambian todo.
Un adolescente ayuda a un solitario millonario londinense a cuidar de la casa vacía que pertenecía a su padre fallecido.

Una crónica de la carrera vanguardista de Mary Tyler Moore, entrelazando su narrativa personal con el ritmo de sus logros profesionales, destacando sus papeles innovadores y el impacto indeleble que tuvo en las posteriores generaciones de mujeres.

Con un nuevo invento que prometía revolucionar los análisis de sangre, Elizabeth Holmes se convirtió en la multimillonaria más joven del mundo, anunciada como la próxima Steve Jobs. Dos años después, su multimillonaria empresa se disolvió.
Emocionó a millones de personas y luchó contra supervillanos como Superman. Tras su accidente, también luchó por los derechos de las personas con discapacidad.

En el año 2000, Wilson regresa a Ciudad de Dios para apoyar la campaña de Barbantinho, pero termina en medio de un conflicto cuando el recién liberado Bradock le exige al actual capo el puesto que cree suyo.

Wilson fotografía la guerra contra las drogas y conoce a Ligia, una reportera que investiga la corrupción policial. Su hija, Leka, intenta iniciar una carrera musical, mientras Berenice trata de mantener a su novio alejado del crimen.

En medio de la guerra territorial, Leka y su grupo de rap cortejan a un productor musical. Lígia y Wilson investigan las acciones de las milicias. PQD aprovecha su experiencia militar para ayudar a Bullfinch. Jerusa organiza una emboscada.

Tras tomar el control, Bradock trata de generar confianza en la comunidad a pesar de su comportamiento errático. Wilson y Lígia descubren una conexión entre un político, las milicias locales y un miembro del círculo de Bradock.
El BOPE invade Ciudad de Dios por órdenes de Reginaldo. Se desata una ola de violencia que obliga a Barbantinho, Berenice y Wilson a enfrentarse a un caos inimaginable e impactante.
Programa que muestra diversos productos para la venta.
Un espacio de cocina con recetas fáciles de preparar y visualmente atractivas en el que Mayffins Cons comparte sus trucos y consejos.
Un espacio que cubre noticias, reseñas y cultura gamer, con conductores que interactúan en un formato divertido y amigable, ¡no es un solo gamer tag, sino un show sobre el mundo de los videojuegos!
Equipos de diseño transforman los espacios interiores y exteriores adyacentes.
Una residencia de Nueva York se parece a un rancho; unos refugios caseros franceses bajo una montaña de piedra caliza; una casa de Australia se asemeja a un insecto gigante; un apartamento de Rusia.

Una pareja de Phoenix, Arizona, busca una vivienda en las montañas de Carolina del Sur. Él quiere un estudio en el que pueda trabajar en sus composiciones musicales, y ella espera poder dejar su impronta en la decoración de la casa.
Una familia compuesta por cinco miembros quiere una casa en las montañas en Kirkwood, California, donde pueden relajarse y olvidar el estrés y la competitividad de Silicon Valley.
EJ y Jason tienen lista su primera renovación y van a mostrarla. Dani y Jon tienen problemas con una casa terminada que no se vende, pero un posible comprador aparece.

El patio trasero de ensueño de una pareja se convierte en una pesadilla. Kim Wolfe reconstruye sus caóticas y estrechas dependencias en un hogar apto para una familia en crecimiento, junto con el huerto urbano con el que soñaban.
Nancy O'Dell visita las casas de Curtis Stone, Thom Filicia y Kathy Hilton.

Nathan y Jenny diseñan una nueva vivienda para un fabricante de joyas y su hijo. El equipo tendrá que pasar toda la noche para completar el proyecto, debido a que una fuerte lluvia y una mala medición retrasó mucho la construcción.
Un pequeño cuarto de baño es transformado en un clásico espacio lleno de luz natural al que se le agrega un bar-cafetería.
Lugares para vivir en Miami en conexión con la naturaleza.
Los finalistas crean el episodio piloto del programa de diseño de sus sueños; creando un cuarto para los dueños actuales.

Una pareja se muda al valle de Hudson y busca una casa con muchas hectáreas y espacio para invitados y entretenimiento. Davina y Kristin encuentran un diamante en bruto y lo transforman en una casa de ensueño contemporánea de concepto abierto.

Una familia canadiense abandona su quinta en Canadá para mudarse a las playas de Roatán. Intentan formar una nueva vida en una casa más pequeña. El padre quiere una casa para remodelar mientras que la madre desea mudarse de inmediato.

Una pareja ocupada con empleos de tiempo completo y una hija de 12 años buscan una casa en Palm Coast, Florida, donde pueden comenzar sus vacaciones; ella quiere una vista; él quiere un vecindario tranquilo.

Mike, Rich y Jen se preparan para un gran trabajo al considerar dos casas en diferentes estados de deterioro. Una es una casa de 1696 que está literalmente inclinada, y la otra es una casa de 1800 con un exterior sólido que cubre una demolición inacabada.
Renovación de una cocina estancada en la década de 1980 con un estilo francés, adicionando gabinetes de color crema de pared a pared.

Una pareja de D. C. busca una segunda casa con el sentido de pertenencia a la comunidad en Nassau. Ambos buscan un lugar lo suficientemente grande como para recibir de forma cómoda a sus visitantes, con vista al mar y acceso a la playa.

Una pareja de Nueva Jersey quiere cumplir el sueño de toda su vida: comprar una casa cerca de su familia en la zona sur de Nueva York. Esperan encontrar una casa de campo anticuada que puedan renovar.

Los West se enamoraron de la sensación de nostalgia que su casa emitía, pero la falta de comodidades les causa un gran pesar. Kim Wolfe consigue salvar ese encanto que les enamoró mientras hace de la vivienda un lugar cómodo y moderno.

Mike, Jen y Rich consideran dos propiedades muy diferentes entre sí. Una es una casa colonial holandesa cargada de detalles y un precio elevado, mientras que la otra es una casa de 1800 que está llena de potencial.

Un equipo de expertos en campos variados viajan alrededor del mundo para investigar algunos de los misterios que más han perdurado en la raza humana. ¿Quién fue Jack el destripador?, ¿Cuál es el propósito de Stonehenge? ¿Por qué aeroplanos y barcos desaparecen en las aguas del triángulo de las Bermudas?. Los expertos reúnen evidencia y el equipo científico conduce un estudio forense usando la última tecnología. Las conclusiones podrían resultar en una revisión de la historia.
Una investigación de la organización secreta Odessa, formada para ayudar a los nazis a escapar de Alemania después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial para reconstruir un Cuarto Reich.

Rick viaja a Boston para obtener una colección histórica de béisbol de los Red Sox. Corey pone sus ojos en una chaqueta de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Corey y Chum aprenden algunos trucos de un juego de magia antiguo.

Es ist Hal und Lois Hochzeitstag und sie wollen diesen in einem Restaurant feiern. Aber irgendjemand hat Lois Traumkleid angekokelt und diesen jemand will Lois finden.
Lois und Hal sind zu einer Hochzeitsfeier bei Hals Verwandten eingeladen. Lois findet es furchtbar, denn sie wird von Hals Familie einfach nicht akzeptiert.
Malcolm verprügelt einen siebenjährigen Jungen, den auch sonst keiner leiden kann. Danach fühlt sich Malcolm schuldig und sucht sich Rat bei verschiedenen Geistlichen.

Haley und Andy verbringen jede Menge Zeit miteinander. Phil und Claire wissen nicht, was sie davon halten sollen. Gloria stellt einen Spanischlehrer für Manny an. Cam und Mitch treffen einen bekannten Journalisten.
Phil und Luke bereiten das Thanksgiving-Essen vor. Claire bereitet ebenfalls einen Truthahn vor. Jays und Glorias Reise wird in letzter Minute storniert. Lily will kein Kleid anziehen.
Claire und Phil glauben, dass sich Alex ihren Freund einbildet. Manny scheint Jays Plan, nicht auf eine Party gehen zu müssen, zu ruinieren. Es passiert etwas mit Cams und Mitch's neuem Sofa.
Haley hat Geburtstag und die ganze Familie feiert diesen in einer Bar. Phil und Jay machen sich auf den Weg, Haleys Geschenk zu holen und Lily fragt Alex, Luke und Manny, woher Babys kommen.
Eine Nahtoderfahrung verändert das Verhalten einiger Familienmitglieder. Der Rest des Clans erduldet diese charakterlichen Veränderungen.

Leela freundet sich mit einem eifersüchtigen Chatbot an und schafft damit ein besonderes Bündnis. Schon bald geraten die anderen jedoch in Konflikt mit dem Chatbot und wollen, dass Leela die Freundschaft zu dem Eindringling beendet.

Leela will die erste weibliche Major-League-Blernsball-Spielerin werden. Allerdings trifft sie im Training ihren Partner so oft am Kopf, dass dieser bewusstlos wird. Trotzdem wird sie vom Chef einer Profimannschaft engagiert.

Bender kocht leidenschaftlich gern, nur leider nicht gut. Da trifft er den ehemaligen Meisterkoch Spargel, tötet ihn aber versehentlich mit seiner Kochkunst, bevor dieser ihm etwas beibringen kann. Er bittet Bender um einen letzten Gefallen.

Ex-Präsident Richard Nixon will gemeinsam mit Professor Wernstrom alle Roboter der Welt vernichten. Dafür lädt er sie alle auf die Galapagos-Inseln ein, doch ausgerechnet die Abgas-Schleuder von Professor Farnsworth soll sie retten.

Fry ist überglücklich, als bei Ausgrabungen das Fossil seines Hundes geborgen wird. Zunächst ist er auch von Professor Farnsworths Vorschlag, das Tier zu klonen, begeistert. Doch schon kurz darauf kommen ihm Zweifel, ob das wirklich richtig ist.

Professor Farnsworth und Hermes wollen, dass ihre Söhne Cubert und Dwight eigenes Geld verdienen. Darum setzen sie sie auf die Straße, rechnen aber nicht mit der Reaktion ihrer Sprösslinge. Die gründen nämlich ein Konkurrenz-Unternehmen.

Während eines Stromausfalls wegen einer Kollision im Weltraum schwängert Leela versehentlich Kiff. Das macht Amy so sauer, dass sie verschwindet und Kiff mit seiner Schwangerschaft alleine lässt. Doch sie wird von Gewissensbissen geplagt.

Eine Hausierer-Salbe lässt Leela, Fry und Bender zu Superhelden mutieren, die Verbrechen bekämpfen. Sie pfuschen auch dem Zoowärter ins Handwerk, einem Meisterdieb. Der ist über die Störung so wütend, dass er kurz darauf Leelas Eltern entführt.

Professor Farnsworth kann das "Alters-Bakterium" identifizieren und umpolen, sodass er jünger wird. Er hat dabei aber nicht bedacht, dass diese Verjüngung zu einer unkontrollierbaren Rückentwicklung der Menschheit führt.

Andy und Lou nehmen an einer Spielshow teil, ob sie wohl viele Preise abräumen werden? Vicky Pollard hat endlich einen neuen Job gefunden. Sie arbeitet jetzt bei einer Sex-Hotline. Don und Pat erleben Merkwürdiges im indischen Restaurant. Daffyd glaubt an seine Homosexualität, will aber dennoch eine Freundin haben. Denn er hat ja keine andere Wahl.

Ting Tong hat ihre Mutter nach Großbritannien geholt, sie soll in Mikes Wohnung bleiben. Sid Pegg hat ein Treffen einberufen. Bubbles de Vere erfährt, dass ihr Ex-Mann Desiree bevorzugt, weil sie um einiges fülliger ist. Lou und Andy versuchen Andys Frisbee von einem Hochspannungsmast zu holen. Judy und Maggie gehen mit dem Hund spazieren, doch dann dreht Maggie durch.

Captain Freeman beauftragt die Lower Deckers mit einer äußerst kniffligen Mission, um einen selbstzerstörerischen Mariner von Dancer fernzuhalten. Die Mitglieder der Lower Decks müssen ihre Fähigkeiten unter Beweis stellen.

Mariner muss sich vorbereiten, sich ihrer Vergangenheit und einigen alten Bekannten zu stellen. Die Konfrontation mit Ereignissen und Personen bringt nicht nur persönliche Herausforderungen mit sich, sondern stellt auch ihre Loyalität auf die Probe.

Ein Frühstück endet in einer Katastrophe, als klar wird, dass Onkel Steve ein Außerirdischer ist. Er hat falsche Erinnerungen in die Gehirne der Familienmitglieder implantiert, um in ihr Haus einzudringen und will die Welt erobern.
Rick und Morty müssen eine Rettungsaktion planen. Auch eine neue Religion startet durch.
Asskill droht Krapopolis anzugreifen. Tyrannis versucht, ihn durch Diplomatie aufzuhalten.
Tyrannis empfängt andere Könige zu einer Reihe von Spielen in Krapopolis, wo Stupendous glänzt.
Rick vermasselt etwas und bringt damit das gesamte Raum-Zeit-Kontinuum durcheinander. Beth und Jerry kommen sich näher.

Rick und Morty bringen Jerry in eine Kindertagesstätte und Rick bringt Morty das Fahren bei. Morty versucht, das Leben eines Gaswesens zu retten, das von einem Attentäter gejagt wird, dem Rick eine Antimaterie-Waffe verkauft hat.
Rick wird plötzlich richtig emotional. Beth und Jerry drehen beide ein wenig durch.
Tom Allen, a regular on 'The Great British Bake Off: An Extra Slice', shows us around his parents' home. Allan Mustafa, the 'People Just Do Nothing' star gives a tour of his home studio.
While exploring ancient Rome, the teenage witch falls in love with a man who wants to expose her supernatural ties.
Hilda and Zelda decide it's better if they live apart from each other, but Sabrina cannot choose who she prefers.
Sabrina has at last qualified for her witch's licence. Unfortunately, she's not allowed to use it until she discovers her 'Family Secret'.
Whilst trying to help Valerie to overcome an embarrassing moment, Sabrina accidentally transfers the embarrassment to herself instead.
Sabrina hires Roland to spy on Harvey and Libby when they are paired as husband and wife for a class project.
Trouble brews between best friends when Valerie becomes eager to try out for cheerleading, even though Sabrina can't stand the squad's pom-pompous participants.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) becomes hooked on hotcakes; Aunt Hilda (Caroline Rhea) is banished after she fails to fill out some forms.
Valerie invites Justin and Harvey to Sabrina's to watch scary videos at Halloween, but they get to the video shop too late and all that's left is 'The Bridges of Madison County'.
Libby (Jenna Leigh Green) tempts Harvey (Nate Richert) with a convertible; Hilda, Zelda and Sabrina (Caroline Rhea, Beth Broderick, Melissa Joan Hart) become indentured servants.
When her impressive academic achievements fail to bring deserved accolades, Sabrina casts a `just desserts' spell: one bite of the cake makes sure she is appreciated.
Salem and Sabrina accidentally fly Salem's miniature spaceship up Libby's nose and get trapped in her brain. The only way to get out is to make her sneeze!
Sabrina doesn't feel comfortable with her cousin Susie's appearance - she's totally green and warty. But Susie teaches Sabrina a lesson in beauty.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) accidentally erases Christmas from the world's memory and has only 24 hours to restore it.
Valerie starts to become a different person and in fact, she's becoming totally like Sabrina. Meanwhile, Hilda sells Salem's art to a gallery.
Cousin Zsa Zsa pays a visit to the Spellmans and Sabrina gives Harvey some ambition cologne in the hope that he might change his mind about going to college.
Sabrina and Hilda (Melissa Joan Hart, Caroline Rhea) bring back Lucy (guest star Julia Duffy), the former Mrs. Kraft, to break up Zelda's (Beth Broderick) romance with Kraft.
Sabrina buys fake ID cards and loses her magic powers; Other Realm pirates run wild in the Spellman household.
Joey's remarks to a fan magazine could cause him to lose his job playing Dr Ramoray on a daytime television drama, and Chandler's new flatmate Eddie becomes too annoying to cope with.
Chandler wants his annoying new roommate to move out, Joey is forced to face some exorbitant bills, and the girls learn from a book about personal empowerment.
Monica's new boyfriend impresses Chandler and Joey, Phoebe finds out what she missed as a child, and Rachel resents the fact that Ross is planning the rest of their lives together.

Monica is broke and decides to gamble on the stock market, and Chandler and Ross run into a couple of bullies in Central Park. Meanwhile, Rachel and Joey help Phoebe locate her father, but a vicious dog prevents Phoebe from finally meeting him. After accidentally injuring the dog with her car, Phoebe gets to know her father's second wife whom she never knew about and another long-lost family member.

Monica decides to hold a surprise birthday for Rachel, but everything goes wrong when Rachel's estranged parents turn up unexpectedly. The party then splits into two factions: a dreary gathering in Monica's flat, and a college-style drunken party at Chandler and Joey's flat.

Phoebe's submariner boyfriend visits New York on leave from the Navy. Unfortunately, Phoebe catches chicken pox at baby Ben's first birthday party. Meanwhile, when Monica realises that Richard has no real neuroses, she worries that she is too strange for him.

Everyone is surprised when Phoebe's husband, a gay Canadian ice dancer, shows up, as nobody knew she was married. Elsewhere, Chandler reveals his third nipple, and Ross's new relationship is under attack, unbeknown to him.

Monica gets promoted and invites the friends out for dinner to celebrate, but problems arise when the difference in their salaries becomes apparent and the group splits in two. Meanwhile, when Chandler sets a woman up to get a date with her, a case of mistaken identities means that he discovers what she really thought of him.
Joey and Chandler babysit Ben who turns out to be a babe magnet until they accidentally leave him on a bus. Meanwhile, Phoebe loses her job as the singer at Central Perk to Stephanie.

Ross and Julie announce they are getting a cat together, while Rachel gets drunk on a date and all she talks about is Ross. She decides to get closure by calling him and telling his machine she is over him. Meanwhile, Chandler regrets asking Monica to help him lose weight.

Ross agonises over whether he should stay with Julie or date Rachel. The gang encourage him to compare the two, so he starts with a list of Rachel's negative qualities. Unfortunately, Rachel sees the list.

Phoebe finds out that her picture of her father, whom she has never known, is just a generic photograph that comes with the picture frame. Elsewhere, after Ross makes Monica's heater malfunction, her Christmas party guests swelter in the middle of winter.
BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with a brand-new episode of his big show, featuring Shirley Ballas, Judi Love and music from Ball & Boe.

Joey lands a fantastic role on `Days of Our Lives'. Rachel begins dating Russ, who bears an uncanny resemblance to Ross. Meanwhile, Monica rekindles her relationship with `Fun Bobby', only to discover his jovial nature depends on alcohol consumption.

Rachel's free-spirited mother visits and reveals that she wants to end her marriage and experiment sexually. Meanwhile, Carol and Susan prepare for their wedding, with some help from an uncomfortable Ross.
Joey begins dating a stunning fan, only to discover she is rather unhinged. Meanwhile, Ross, missing his former pet monkey Marcel, visits San Diego Zoo to learn of his fate.
Ross reunites with Marcel on the set of a Jean-Claude Van Damme film. Meanwhile, Chandler secures a date with a girl he fancied in fourth grade.

When Monica's parents clear out her old room to install a gym, they unearth an old video of her and Rachel's first prom night. It's obvious from this that Ross is in love with Rachel and, having told him it will never happen, Rachel changes her mind. Elsewhere, Joey gives Chandler a hideous bracelet as a token of his friendship and is mortally offended to hear Chandler saying how terrible it is.

Among the guests at Monica's party is a handsome and sophisticated doctor, but the only problem is that he's old enough to be her father. Meanwhile, Joey buys a big screen TV and two reclining leather armchairs with the money from his `Days of Our Lives' contract.

Everyone at Monica's dad's birthday party finds it amusing that their middle-aged friend, eye-doctor Richard Burke, is dating a woman in her 20s - until Monica's parents learn that it is their daughter. Meanwhile, Chandler and Joey row over a dirty spoon. Is the flat still big enough for both of them?
With Joey in his new flat, Chandler gets a troublesome new flatmate. Phoebe makes a video for 'Smelly Cat' and Ross and Monica find it nearly impossible to live together.
Six-time award-winning Mr. Bean proves that silence can say it all! With a teddy, a raised eyebrow, and zero common sense, Rowan Atkinson’s icon turns everyday moments into pure, wordless joy.
Mr Bean goes Christmas shopping, conducts a Salvation Army band, and has Christmas dinner with his long-suffering girlfriend.
Mr Bean treats himself to a weekend at a posh hotel where he manages to get himself into one embarrassing situation after another.
Mr Bean throws a New Year's Eve party, finds some bargains at a sale, and creates havoc when he decorates his room.
Michael McIntyre hosts as Chris McCausland, Gabby Logan, GK Barry, Iain Stirling, Liza Tarbuck, Rachel Riley and Trevor Nelson try to help the contestants answer their way to a fortune.

Psychotic LA cop Martin Riggs and his long-suffering partner Roger Murtaugh are assigned to guard an embezzling accountant due to testify before a federal commission. At first, they think it is a routine piece of work, but they soon discover that their charge has been laundering money for the same South African narcotics syndicate they have been trying to crack.

A judge's decision brings tears of joy to a young mother during the holidays; a man curses at a judge in a virtual hearing and blames his pet for the outburst; a jury makes a crucial error when voting on the death penalty in a murder trial; and more.
Chaos erupts as a defendant attacks the bailiff; a convicted murderer calls the detectives in his case idiots; a defendant keeps firing his court-appointed lawyers; and more.
A road rage suspect attacks a bailiff in court; a grieving mother screams at the hit-and-run driver who killed her daughter; a jury bungles the sentencing phase of a murder trial.

A defendant is held in contempt after dropping an f-bomb in the courtroom; an elderly woman takes her son to court for withholding her late husband's ashes; a grieving widow has harsh words for the owners of the dogs who killed her husband; and more.

A judge has harsh words for a man arrested for throwing his iguana at a restaurant manager; a man accused of domestic violence goes to jail after violating a no-contact order by showing up to court with his alleged victim; and more.

Two disgraced fishing champions apologise for cheating, grieving parents confront the former police officer who killed their son, a man suspected of driving with a suspended licence appears in virtual court from a car, and more.

After a failed plea for leniency, an angry mother flips the bird to the media after her son is sentenced; a grieving woman begs the judge to keep her brother in prison; a judge must use his mute button to silence a foul-mouthed mum.

A judge chastises a defendant for his courtroom outburst; a convicted murderer's mother tells the court that she used methamphetamine with him the day he shot his boss; A defendant threatens to sue the judge after an unfavourable decision.

A judge apologises to the children of a murdered woman for not being able to give their mother's killer a harsher sentence; a woman being sent to jail for violating her probation accidentally curses at the judge before leaving her virtual hearing.
A man accused of owing $12,000 in child support wants a male judge. A man charged with Driving Without a Valid License gets caught driving to court for his arraignment.
A Florida tourist decides to take a scenic car drive through the ocean; a fugitive fleeing from police hides in plain sight; a neighbourhood vandal wears the proof of her crimes.
A traffic stop leads to a shocking arrest; a driver flees an accident with a man clinging to the hood of her car; a man tries to poison his nephew's sandwich.
A woman alerts police to a crime she's committing, a golf game leads to one player to see red on the green, a man wants to get paid by police during a traffic stop, and more.

A man with a late-night urge to relieve himself picks an unusual spot to go; a fugitive leads police on a wild foot chase down the middle of a busy motorway; a woman involved in a fender bender has an over-the-top reaction.

The father of four children, Gregory Rice vanished without a trace. Weeks later, fishermen made a grisly discovery in the Little Pee Dee River, his body wrapped in a tarp, unravelling a murder mystery steeped in deception and a hidden affair.
While visiting his girlfriend's family on Christmas Eve, 25-year-old Clevee Chick is gunned down by two men who knock and open fire.

After a beloved teacher is gunned down in broad daylight, Gwinnett detectives must track down the suspects, with only their getaway car's description. In the pursuit of justice, the prosecution must overcome the threat of a mistrial.
In 2003, Katie Sepich disappeared after leaving a house party in Las Cruces. As the case stalled, her mother began a determined search for answers.

The oldest serial killer in America reveals new information about his crimes in his first televised interview. Journalist David Scott confronts Gary Hilton about his killing spree when he preyed on hikers in North Carolina, Georgia and Florida.
New York, 1989. Five Black and Latino teenagers face intense scrutiny in a Central Park case that raises troubling questions about justice.

When a predator with a disturbing past targets a minor, law enforcement agencies team up for a high-stakes takedown at a busy airport. Then, a mum uncovers a predator's twisted scheme. Detectives unmask one of their boldest predators yet.
Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.
Melodious recitation of the Holy Qur'an with English translation.
Examines the companions of the Holy Prophet, their exemplary life, and example.
Lecture titled 'Good and Evil, is it all from Allah?' delivered by Faraz Khan.
The history and compilation of the Qur'an.
A lecture series by Ml. Farouk Soofie. The focus is manners and behaviour acceptable to societal Norms.
Documentary on Neanderthals, an extinct species of humans. The documentary looks into the scientific study of these beings of the past.
Ntokozo Hlongwane talks to an inspired audience in Durban, City Hall about How To Pass Matric With Maximum Distinctions, his highly influential book which has sent matric pass rates through the roof.
A palaeontology documentary on Dinosaurs. The focus is on Spinosaurus aegyptiacus.
Lecture on the control of one's inhibitions and becoming an internal activist in the quest for spiritual attainment.
Lecture on the importance of managing one's time.

Khaleesi, the golden retriever pup undergoes a life-saving procedure; vet tech Blaire faces heartbreak over her beloved senior dog, Zula; during the global pandemic, Dr. Jeff and Hector ensure pets from an elderly community receive proper care.
Truckers share their real journeys through long hours, heavy loads, and busy roads.
Russell heads to Belgium to deliver a load of bacon.
Mario and Uwe face difficulties en route to Mallorca, Louise continues her journey to Switzerland, and Russell heads to Scotland with 23 tons of beef.
When the frame on Heavy D's quick flip is unsalvageable, he turns it into the ultimate mud truck, and Chavis takes his custom race truck to a competition.
The Dieselsellerz crew race to finish their monster mud truck, and The Muscle rushes to get a buyer for the Denali he bought without Heavy D's permission.
Heavy D finally finishes the Fail of the Year UTV. The gridiron comes to the garage when NFL legend Marshawn Lynch asks the guys to build him a Beast Mode UTV.
Rick hires an engineer to see if he can mine again this season. Parker's crew struggles to keep four plants running. Tony tries to double his gold.

Chase and the crew seek to turn a vacation cabin that was originally a 1920s horse barn into a stable building for a large family. Drawing from the past, the crew wants to honour the owners' late parents in this emotional build.

A family of four is building a luxury glamping escape overlooking the Texas Hill Country, but the build process is anything but glamorous; with the rain, challenging terrain and critters, they must work together to get to the finish line.

Jamie battles searing pain and a deadly infection after the stingray attack. Malu and Mandy struggle with Ana Lis' survival priorities. All of the camps finally meet and combine their map pieces for rescue.

A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

Dr. Jeff makes a shocking discovery when a rescued street pup named Kova comes in with a severely injured leg; little Fonda needs to find a forever home after being thrown from a car; Dr. Jeff builds his beloved dog Fred his very own swimming pool.
At Biggin Hill, Bruce visits a collector's haul of WWII Spitfires. Plus, the twins prepare some WWII artillery guns to export to Australia, but it's no easy feat.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair visit two amazing sets of sheds in the Oxfordshire and Hampshire area. In the heart of Oxfordshire they find rare Minis, 1970s Rollers, and a pristine rally car. The Hampshire sheds are full to the rafters with Japanese bikes, but they come away with a real surprise. Selling their projects on, however, proves to be a real challenge.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, on the Cornish coast, Henry and Sam spend the day surrounded by vintage vehicles with genteel pedigrees including the first ever Lotus Elan, and a pre-war Sunbeam. In Oxfordshire, Sam falls for a Midget racer - but the restoration is a daunting task.

The boys are in Oxfordshire, and Mark's shed is more of a boneyard for giants. Everything Henry and Sam look at here is oversized and likely overpriced, but Henry likes a tractor in blue and Sam falls for a Midget racer in a hedge.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in Somerset where they discover an amazing collection of Norton motorbikes, Italian mopeds and French go-karts. Moving on to Hertfordshire, they find vintage cars, obscure tractors and rare British bikes from the 1950s. Everything is going well, but when the haggling starts, things don't turn out quite how anyone expected.

Today the Shed and Buried boys are moving on to Hertfordshire, where they find vintage cars, obscure tractors and rare British bikes from the 1950s. It's all going well, but when the haggling starts, things don't turn out quite how anyone expected.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in the Cotswolds where they discover sheds full of stationary engines, obscure agricultural implements and some very surprising collections of memorabilia. Moving on up to Sussex, they go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and find in its dark corners and dusty attics, two extraordinary hidden gems.
French polisher Alex is challenged to rescue a settle bed. James gets to work restoring a Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine to its former glory, whilst Ted works on two weathered chairs.
Sculptor Nick is tasked with transforming a pair of headless garden ornaments into something worth looking at. Drew asks leather restorer Martin to breathe life back into an Avro Anson chair.
Lighting expert Jolene is challenged to restore an unusual Empire chandelier. James works on a Seeburg jukebox to bring back the music, and Ann-Marie is handed a damaged book to restore.
Some of the brightest minds and theorists on the planet explore the limits of human knowledge and explain the science behind the rules of the universe.
26,000 light-years away at the heart of the galaxy lies a massive black hole. How can something so far away be studied, and what could it teach scientists?

The discovery of extraterrestrial life might face an impossible challenge: the physics of the universe itself; using cutting-edge tech, experts might be on the verge of a groundbreaking find, and the evidence could already be in hand.
James heads to the Amazon to investigate the mysterious disappearance of jungle explorer, Colonel Percy Fawcett, in a quest that becomes more dangerous than he could have ever imagined.
James Cracknell travels to Southern Africa to follow in the footsteps of celebrated explorer Dr David Livingstone. He encounters some of Africa's most dangerous animals along the way.
James Cracknell takes on one of the hottest, most extreme terrains in the world, as he investigates what the early pioneers of America's Gold Rush went through in pursuit of riches.
Bruce gets hold of an extremely rare, and valuable, German Panther tank, and its original undercoat is more pink than camouflage. But getting parts is a struggle.
Find out how champagne tops, pneumatic delivery systems, espresso machines, and pizza ovens are made.
Find out how stile and rail doors, steam cleaners, hand-held pizza, and power brushes are made.
Ever wondered how a Lotus Evora is made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace and explore its gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Bentley Mulsanne? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Chevrolet Camaro? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Porsche Panamera? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.
A Missouri man who claims UFOs are stalking him contacts Chuck and the team for help. Their investigation uncovers a dark secret which may explain this reported activity.

US astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken return to Earth in a watery splashdown that caps a milestone NASA and SpaceX mission; live coverage of their return reveals what they discovered and what it takes to come home.
Storage sheds; industrial fans; parchment paper; climbing walls.
Examines how items such as precast concrete walls, 3D printers, telescopic cranes, and kerosene lamp burners are made.
See how car headlamps, directional drills, and combs are made, and watch stained glass being restored.
Explores the production processes of handcrafted skis, septic tanks, hydro-formed chassis parts, and aquarium windows.
A recent UFO sighting in Phoenix leads Chuck and the team to Sedona, Arizona. They explore whether the area's energy vortexes act as portals for otherworldly visitors.
After an informant tells of an alien that reportedly escaped from Area 51, Chuck and the team go to Tonopah, Nevada, to investigate whether it still roams the area.
An aggressive spirit attacks guests at a historic hotel in Juneau, Alaska, and a shape-shifting menace could be responsible for thousands of abductions in the Alaska Triangle.
In 1918, the SS Princess Sophia mysteriously sank near Juneau, Alaska. Experts look for answers to the shipwreck as a ghost hunter tries to contact her victims.
Learn how decadent champagne, powerful turbochargers and ATMs are made.
More everyday items go under scrutiny when objects including sharpening steels, kayak paddles, bladder pumps, and ironing boards are dissected to reveal their fundamentals.
Henry and Guy go to Wiltshire to see Phil Pearce, where they find sheds full of tractors, classic cars and police bikes. Phil may have to drive a hard bargain.
Henry and Fuzz are back in Durham visiting a passionate collector of vintage cars and automobilia, where a Dot three-wheeled motorcycle catches their eye.

Just one month after the newly constructed Nipigon River Bridge opened, a winter storm caused a failure in all forty bolts attaching a main deck girder. The subsequent highway closure forced travellers to temporarily detour hundreds of kilometres.

Catastrophe strikes as one of America's most vital freeway intersections erupts in flames and completely collapses in San Francisco; experts use the latest science to investigate how an overturned tanker truck spawned a devastating inferno.

A devastating railroad inferno takes down a vital route on a historic river crossing in Arizona; using the latest cutting-edge technology, experts investigate the remaining incinerated evidence to determine what caused such a disastrous derailment.

Tragedy strikes in Cincinnati as a sudden bridge collapse leaves one of America's busiest motorways at a complete standstill; using scientific methods, expert engineers investigate and reveal how a routine demolition unfolded so disastrously wrong.

A flash flood catastrophe brings one of America's most vital motorways to a complete standstill in the California desert; using scientific methods, expert engineers investigate and discover how its bridge foundations lacked a crucial element.
Paul and Drew check out a BMW 323i that's been sitting in a barn for 12 years. Drew wants to give the car a tasteful revamp, but Paul has a flashier plan.
The restoration of a rare Japanese icon is a chance for Drew to pay homage to one of his automotive heroes. However, work stalls when Paul struggles to find essential parts he needs.
A classic Fiat 124 Spider race car offers the boys the chance to be able to fulfil their heritage racing dreams. However, it's a tight fit and Drew despises its green colour scheme.

Henry and Sam set off down to Ray's shop to sell a bike, but while there, they discover that Ray has plenty for the boys to rummage around in. They have a wonderful day, but come away with less than they want.

The deal-searching duo are near Preston at Graham's place. They discover that Graham is also keen on military gear and Americana. In the end, though, Henry and Sam come away with something a little unusual and decide to put it to the test.

Henry and Sam are in the Lancashire countryside at John's garage, where they're surrounded by hundreds of trinkets. They encounter various military vehicles and treasures, and also a lovely old petrol pump.

Henry and Sam have crossed the Irish Sea to search the sheds of Northern Ireland, and they find a vast collection of everything that they love. Will they be able to return to Oxfordshire with what they want?
Henry and Guy are invited to Yeomans in Worcestershire, which is packed to the rafters with classic British motorbikes, but it may be a challenge to get some of them running.
Henry and Fuzz visit an ex-commercial pilot with two hangars' worth of stuff. He's got classic cars and even planes, but a BSA with missing parts may prove to be a bridge too far.

In der Steiermark warten Rotorblätter auf den Abtransport, denn an der Pretulalpe wird ein neuer Windpark gebaut, der rund 26 500 Haushalte mit Strom aus Windenergie versorgen wird. Manfred und Roland sollen die Fracht sicher am Ziel abliefern.

Verdorbene Lebensmittel können Infektionskrankheiten auslösen. Deshalb dürfen Passagiere aus Nicht-EU-Ländern am Flughafen in Venedig kein Fleisch und keine Milchprodukte einführen. Da machen die Grenzschützer in dieser Folge keine Ausnahme.

Aufhellende Hautcremes enthalten schädliche Substanzen wie Hydrochinon, Steroide, Blei und Quecksilber, die schwere Gesundheitsschäden hervorrufen können. Deshalb dürfen diese Kosmetikartikel nicht in die EU eingeführt werden.

Soon, the promise of fun turns into one misadventure after another for the next generation of Griswolds and anyone who encounters them.

When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos!

Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. Twenty-thousand years ago, Earth was a wondrous, prehistoric world filled with great danger, not the least of which is the beginning of the Ice Age. To avoid a terrible frostbite, the planet's majestic creatures - and a few small, slothful ones - begin migrating south. The story revolves around sub-zero heroes: a woolly mammoth, a saber-toothed tiger, a sloth and a prehistoric combination of a squirrel and rat, known as Scrat.

With global warming threatening their once-icy domain with widespread flooding, Manny (Ray Romano), Sid (John Leguizamo) and Diego (Denis Leary) set out to find a safe haven. Along the way, another mammoth (Queen Latifah), who thinks she is an opossum, joins the travelers on their perilous quest.

A young circus elephant is born with comically large ears and given the cruel nickname Dumbo. One day at a show, he is taunted by a group of kids, inciting his mother into a rage that gets her locked up. After Dumbo's ears cause an accident that injures many of the other elephants, he is made to dress like a clown and perform dangerous stunts. Everything changes when Dumbo discovers that his enormous ears actually allow him to fly, and he astounds everyone at the circus with his new talent.

Elite Navy SEAL Shane Wolfe (Vin Diesel) can handle just about anything thrown his way, but even the best have their limits. When he fails to keep scientist Howard Plummer (Tate Donovan) safe from assassination, Wolfe has a shot at redemption by being assigned to protect Plummer's five children, including rebellious Zoe (Brittany Snow), Seth (Max Thieriot) and clingy Lulu (Morgan York). More than a handful, these kids -- and their pet duck -- are pushing this seasoned warrior to the edge.

Workaholic Howard Langston (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wants to make things up to his son, Jamie (Jake Lloyd), and wife, Liz (Rita Wilson). He promises to get Jamie the hottest toy of the season, Turbo-Man -- even though it's Christmas Eve and the toy is practically sold out. As Langston hunts down the elusive gift, he runs into mailman Myron (Sinbad), another father on the same quest. With the clock winding down, Langston's moral code is tested as he starts to learn the real meaning of Christmas.

In this live-action adaptation of the beloved children's tale by Dr. Seuss, the reclusive green Grinch (Jim Carrey) decides to ruin Christmas for the cheery citizens of Whoville. Reluctantly joined by his hapless dog, Max, the Grinch comes down from his mountaintop home and sneaks into town to swipe everything holiday-related from the Whos. However, the bitter grump finds a hitch in his plans when he encounters the endearing Cindy Lou Who (Taylor Momsen).

Jessica sends Christmas cards to five people who have greatly impacted her life, including the aunt who raised her, her brother, an aging pop star, the teacher that inspired her and her friend that always tells the truth.
Inspired by Scotty McCreery's song "Five More Minutes," a woman's Christmas wish is answered in unexpected ways when her late grandfather's journal turns up and reveals an untold romance.
When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad Morgan travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother Jo, a big family secret is revealed.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.
While settling his father's estate, a man becomes suspicious as to why the man left his nurse a large sum of money after knowing her for less than two months before he died.
Michaela helps her nephew create a Christmas Scrapbook for his mom serving overseas by teaming with his teacher Bryan. Their unexpected romance proves love can be the greatest homecoming of all.

While rich businessman Mike O'Connor (Charles Ruggles) resides in Virginia, his luxury town house in New York City appears vacant. Mac invites Jim (Don DeFore), an unemployed veteran who has just been evicted from a building owned by O'Connor, to stay at the house without revealing he's squatting. When O'Connor's daughter, Trudy (Gale Storm), shows up as well, she falls for Jim and tries to help him.

Noticiero deportivo que combina análisis y opinión, ofreciendo diferentes ángulos para desarrollar las noticias más importantes del mundo del deporte.
Aquí el fútbol se habla como lo vive el jugador, sin gritos, ni poses, solo debate auténtico.
Un programa para conocer más sobre el fútbol centroamericano con periodistas especializados de Guatemala, Costa Rica, Honduras, El Salvador y Panamá.

Fútbol americano de la NCAA. Semana 10. UCLA enfrenta a Minnesota. Desde el Huntington Bank Stadium. Los Bruins, quinto sembrado de la nación busca seguir su camino perfecto e imponerse en su sexto juego de la Big Ten den la temporada.

Roberto Carlos revolucionó el fútbol, al igual que las legendarias selecciones de Uruguay, el imperturbable Fabien Barthez de Francia y la Irlanda de Jack Charlton, que cambiaron las reglas del juego.

Kylian Mbappé es el rostro más actual del escenario más importante del fútbol. Ganó la Copa Mundial de FIFA 2018 cuando aún era adolescente y fue autor de un triplete en la final del Mundial. Mbappé ya es toda una leyenda del fútbol francés.
Andrés Iniesta y Xavi Hernández formaron la mejor dupla de mediocampistas de la historia de los Mundiales.

Gimnasia La Plata recibe a Belgrano en la fecha 16 del Torneo Clausura 2026 de la LPF. La Plata viene de vencer a Estudiantes RC, mientras que Belgrano viene de empatar ante Barracas Central. Desde el estadio Juan Carmelo Zerillo, en La Plata.

Unión de Santa Fe recibe a Vélez Sarsfield por la fecha 16 de la Zona A del Torneo Clausura 2026. El Tatengue tiene un último intento para clasificar a la postemporada, mientras que El Fortín busca tomar la segunda posición del grupo.

Banfield recibe a Rosario Central en el estadio Florencio Sola por la fecha 16 de la Zona B. El Taladro necesita un triunfo tras perder dos juegos, mientras que El Decano viene de caer ante Argentinos Juniors.
Ariel Rodríguez y su equipo explican la actualidad de la Liga Profesional y las copas internacionales.
Fecha 16 de la Zona A del Torneo Clausura 2026 de la LPF. Talleres de Córdoba recibe al Estudiantes. Desde el estadio Mario Alberto Kempes, en Córdoba.
La mirada de los analistas más destacados en un espacio que combina información, debate, actualidad y los informes más originales.
Cobertura de la fecha 16 del Torneo Clausura 2026 de la LPF, con los encuentros de: Boca Juniors vs. Defensa y Justicia. Rosario Central vs. Estudiantes (RC). Argentinos Juniors vs. Huracán.
Los estilos bien definidos le ponen pimienta al mediodía. Análisis, entrevistas, móviles y el debate futbolero de la mesa más picante de la TV de Argentina.

After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.
Alex and Sam try to manage their unaddressed personal crises while keeping up appearances at the Women's Literature Awards ceremony. Later, Ruari gets irritated with Alex.
Bertha faces Gladys's difficult childbirth, Peggy achieves a milestone and Agnes makes plans to host a prestigious dinner.

Migo is a friendly Yeti whose world gets turned upside down when he discovers something that he didn't know existed -- a human. He soon faces banishment from his snowy home when the rest of the villagers refuse to believe his fantastic tale. Hoping to prove them wrong, Migo embarks on an epic journey to find the mysterious creature that can put him back in good graces with his simple community.

Acerbic comic Bill Maher welcomes a panel of guests from diverse parts of the political spectrum for a lively discussion of current events, as well as offering his own perspective on contemporary issues.

With only two days before the trial begins, Molly grows increasingly concerned about an inaccurate asset list, while Johnny tries to minimize the situation; faced with troubling information, Serena and Nick hold interviews with their attorneys on the case; St. John denies all knowledge of David's arrangement.

The true story of a team of unlikely underdogs -- a working-class gamer, a former race car driver, and an idealistic motorsport executive -- who risk it all to take on the most elite sport in the world.
Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood, where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

London undergoes a citywide evacuation when an unexploded World War II bomb is unearthed at a busy construction site. Amid the escalating tension and chaos, a daring criminal operation is set in motion -- one that uses the evacuation as a cover for a meticulously planned bank heist. As authorities race against time to contain the crisis, alliances blur and moral boundaries are crossed.

In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history.

In 1977, paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine Warren come out of a self-imposed sabbatical to travel to Enfield, a borough in north London. There, they meet Peggy Hodgson, an overwhelmed single mother of four who tells the couple that something evil is in her home. Ed and Lorraine believe her story when the youngest daughter starts to show signs of demonic possession. As the Warrens try to help the besieged girl, they become the next targets of the malicious spirit.
In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.
Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell Stewart becomes one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s.

To push the crime rate below one percent for the rest of the year, the New Founding Fathers of America try a radical sociological experiment that allows citizens to vent their aggression for one night in an isolated community. The idea soon explodes across the nation when the violence of the oppressors meets the rage of the marginalized.

Charlie Heller is a brilliant CIA decoder whose world comes crashing down when his wife dies in a London terrorist attack. When his supervisors refuse to take action, his intelligence becomes the ultimate weapon as he embarks on a dangerous trek across the globe to track down those responsible.
Kevin tries to suppress his bad habits while tracking down a deer; Laurie receives some news; Tom connects with his past; Nora has a job interview; Kevin Senior receives an honor.

An unexpected ally helps Kevin; Mapleton is plunged into chaos by the Guilty Remnant's elaborate Memorial Day initiative; Holy Wayne grants a final wish; Tom copes with his new reality; Nora makes a decision.

A Texas town in which no one departed becomes a magnet for tourists and people; John Murphy gets an ominous warning; Kevin, Nora and Jill arrive in Miracle; Kevin and the Murphy family experience a mysterious event.
Kevin, Nora and Jill try to pick up the pieces in the aftermath of the Mapleton riots; Nora makes an impulsive choice; Kevin becomes entangled in the Murphy family's problems.
Laurie and Tom's work to rescue lost souls takes a toll on them; Laurie tries to spread the word about the dangers of the Guilty Remnant; Tom's infiltration of the cult uncovers new problems.
Nora awakens in the midst of an earthquake to find Kevin missing; the Murphys are left reeling after Evie's disappearance; Kevin returns home with no memory of the night before; an old enemy returns.
Rev. Matt Jamison takes his wife outside Miracle to seek answers about her condition; Matt struggles to keep Mary safe from desperate tourists outside the town's gates.
Nora is irritated by unexpected visitors; Kevin's predicament becomes impossible to ignore; Erika finds an unlikely ally and reveals haunting secrets.
Nora gives Kevin and Jill some news; Laurie makes a rash decision; Kevin explores his options to tackle a problem.
Questions and answers emerge in the wake of Kevin's desperate decision to vanquish Patti; the world adjusts to the repercussions of what comes next.
Meg suffers a personal loss and heads out on a pilgrimage to Miracle; after a fallout with Laurie, Tom seeks to reunite with Meg.
Kevin comes clean to John about his connection to Evie's disappearance; Miracle faces an unexpected threat on the fourth anniversary of the Departure.

Three years after Miracle, Texas, was overrun by the Guilty Remnant, Kevin Garvey returns to his role as chief of police; as the seventh anniversary of the Sudden Departure approaches, many believe another apocalyptic event will happen.

As a fraud investigator for the Department of Sudden Departure, Nora travels to St. Louis to investigate a possible scam that involves convincing family members of the Departed of a way to see their loved ones again.
Emboldened by a vision, Kevin Garvey Sr. wanders the Australian outback in an effort to save the world from apocalypse.

Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool meets Russell, an angry teenage mutant who lives at an orphanage. When Russell becomes the target of Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future -- Deadpool realizes that he'll need some help saving the boy from such a superior enemy. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other powerful mutants to protect young Russell from Cable and his advanced weaponry.
Emmy-winning writer, New York Times bestselling author and SNL alum Seth Meyers stars in his first HBO stand-up special.

Ramy Youssef returns to the stage to offer his unique reflections on a divided world, the unexpected perils of charitable giving, the 2024 presidential election, prayer, and a childhood book report that changed the course of his life.

Ramy engages with the audience as he approaches an ample spectrum of personal topics, both relatable and genuinely serious, all while doing so with the belief that people can find light and hope in all things if they just try to see them through a lens of love; whether it's his marriage, being a dog parent, AI, or religion, Ramy comes at everything with his own brand of heart and humor.

Debuting original material about the shared experiences as humans, tackling topics like family, religion and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity; expecting an original and unforgettable experience, filmed at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles.

Comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first stand-up special; a performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another, from Trader Joe's to Oreos, NPR and dog breeds; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more.

Mumble (Elijah Wood) the penguin, now called the Master of Tap, has an unusual problem: Erik, his son, is reluctant to dance. Erik runs away from home and encounters the Mighty Sven (Hank Azaria) -- a penguin that can fly. Poor Mumble can't compete with Erik's unusual new role model. But, when the world is shaken by powerful forces, Erik gets a chance to see his father's true colors as Mumble gathers all creatures great and small to set things right again.
Movie, Animated, Children, Adventure, Musical, Comedy

It's summer, and Greg Heffley (Zachary Gordon) is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad (Steve Zahn) has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club. But Greg's plan backfires, leaving him in the middle of embarrassing mishaps and a camping trip gone wrong.

Settled in with the Brown family, Paddington the bear is a popular member of the community who spreads joy and marmalade wherever he goes. One fine day, he spots a pop-up book in an antique shop, the perfect present for his beloved aunt's 100th birthday. When a thief steals the prized book, Paddington embarks on a quest to unmask the culprit before Aunt Lucy's big celebration.
After a surprising diagnosis, Alex deals with Ruari's graduation stunt, her ex's decision to move to Canada, and a setup with an older man.
Alex has a delicate meeting with the agency's most successful author, in addition to trying to get Ruari to open up and reconnect with Patrick.
At the Frankfurt Book Fair, Alex tries to keep Ruari occupied while being bombarded by the viral success of Malcolm's self-published novel.
Sam tasks Alex with the unpleasant job of winning Malcolm back as a client; Alex leans on Michael during a family dinner.

Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart).
